The image is the scene to animate, not an introduction to a different scene. Preserve the original cast and setting without substitutions or unrelated scene changes. The camera smoothly tracks the requested action, keeping the original cast visible. The owner requests: [VISUAL INSTRUCTIONS — DO NOT SPEAK] Animate the provided image exactly as it is. STRICT IMAGE PRESERVATION: Do not modify, replace, redesign or remove anything from the original image. Preserve all faces, characters, clothing, football uniforms, team logos, colors, positions, background elements, and the "SÉRIE B" sign. Behind them, the Mirassol lion mascot, the Mirassol football player and the giant white Serie B ghost chase them together. The lion runs aggressively, roaring and moving its paws. The Mirassol player runs excitedly, laughing and celebrating. The Serie B ghost floats forward rapidly, stretching its arms toward the fleeing Corinthians characters. The chasing characters chant together in Brazilian Portuguese, mocking the Corinthians supporters. Camera tracks backward smoothly, maintaining the original composition and keeping all six characters visible. Natural running movements, synchronized footsteps, flying dust, energetic comic-book animation and stadium atmosphere. Preserve the original illustration style throughout the entire sequence. Keep running during dialogue. Preserve distinct stride phases for multiple runners. Pursuers follow behind when requested. The bodies articulate continuously; camera movement alone does not fulfill the action. Do not force a return to the opening pose unless a loop or final reference was explicitly supplied.
